## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Strategy and permissions

State whether selection, numerical limits, information cutoffs, timing, ownership or permissions change. Identify the evaluation version and approval needed for any material rule change.

## Validation

List actual commands and results. Distinguish synthetic, historical, shadow and broker observations. Record missing inputs and unexecuted checks.

## Data and execution

Confirm the patch contains no credentials, private account records or vendor inputs. State whether any runtime or execution capability changes; default remains shadow.
